objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: maayos na follow-up.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: following up constructively.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pag-follow-up nang kalmado at may tiyak na tanong ay mas epektibo kaysa sa reklamong walang tiyak na hinihingi.
sections.takeaway_en: Following up calmly and with a specific question works better than a complaint with no specific ask.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang katahimikan sa harap ng pagkaantala ay hindi pagiging magalang — madalas itong nagpapahaba lang ng problemang kaya sanang naayos nang maaga.
sections.takeaway_en: Staying silent in the face of a delay isn't politeness — it often just lets a problem drag on that could have been fixed much sooner.

options.fil: Kalmadong itanong ang status, kulang na dokumento, at susunod na hakbang.
options.en: Calmly ask about status, missing documents and the next step.

options.fil: Magalit agad bago alamin ang dahilan.
options.en: Become angry before checking the reason.

check.feedback_fil: Kalmadong itanong ang status, kulang na dokumento, at susunod na hakbang. Ipaliwanag ang dahilan gamit ang sitwasyon sa aralin.
check.feedback_en: Calmly ask about status, missing documents and the next step. Explain why using the lesson situation.
